chapters.title: Cutline
chapters.subtitle: A native video editor for iPhone
chapters.text: Meet Cutline, a video editor for iPhone that's fast, private, and runs entirely on your device. No account, no uploads, and no watermark. Let's take a quick tour.

chapters.title: Projects & Import
chapters.subtitle: Autosaved · 200-step undo
chapters.text: Start a new project and bring in your clips. Media is copied into the project, so every change is saved automatically, with deep undo and redo.

chapters.title: Timeline & Preview
chapters.subtitle: UIKit timeline · Metal rendering
chapters.text: The timeline is built for smooth scrolling. Scrub to any frame, pinch to zoom, and the preview renders every effect live on the GPU.

chapters.title: Split · Trim · Arrange
chapters.subtitle: Frame-accurate editing
chapters.text: Editing is quick. Split at the playhead, drag the handles to trim, duplicate clips, and undo anything with a single tap.

chapters.title: Speed · Reverse · Freeze
chapters.subtitle: 0.1× to 10×
chapters.text: Change the speed anywhere from a tenth to ten times, play a clip in reverse, or add a freeze frame to hold a moment.

chapters.title: Filters & Adjustments
chapters.subtitle: 20 looks baked into 3D LUTs
chapters.text: Twenty built-in looks are baked into 3D lookup tables, so any filter costs a single texture read per pixel. Then fine-tune contrast, exposure, vignette and more.

chapters.title: Auto Enhance
chapters.subtitle: On-device AI
chapters.text: Or just tap Auto Enhance. Cutline measures the footage and corrects exposure, contrast and colour in one step.

chapters.title: Animated Text
chapters.subtitle: Fonts · outlines · motion
chapters.text: Add titles with custom fonts, outlines and animations like pop, rise and typewriter, and drag them anywhere on the canvas.

chapters.title: Transitions
chapters.subtitle: 8 GPU transitions
chapters.text: Between clips, choose from eight transitions, including dissolve, zoom, slide, wipe and glitch.

chapters.title: Music & Beat Sync
chapters.subtitle: On-device AI
chapters.text: Pick a royalty-free track. Cutline detects the beats on device, and Beat Sync lines your cuts up with the music automatically.

chapters.title: Remove Silence
chapters.subtitle: On-device AI
chapters.text: Remove Silence finds the pauses in your speech and cuts them out in one tap, closing the gaps for you.

chapters.title: Any Format
chapters.subtitle: 9:16 · 1:1 · 4:5 · 16:9
chapters.text: Switch between square, portrait, widescreen and vertical at any time, with a blurred or solid background filling the frame.

chapters.title: Auto Reframe
chapters.subtitle: Vision face & subject tracking
chapters.text: Auto Reframe tracks faces and subjects through the shot, so a wide clip fills a vertical video and keeps the person in frame.

chapters.title: Export
chapters.subtitle: Up to 4K60 · HEVC · hardware encoder
chapters.text: Finally, export up to 4K at sixty frames per second in HEVC or H.264, using the hardware encoder. Then save to Photos, or share.

chapters.title: Cutline v1
chapters.subtitle: Swift · Metal · on-device AI
chapters.text: That's Cutline version one, built natively in Swift, with Metal and Apple's on-device frameworks. Thanks for watching.
